evidenceBoundary: Official product documentation plus offline serialized-transport tests; no live provider permission, private networking, billing, cleanup or durability certification.

hosting.nativeContract: Service references resolve DATABASE_URL and RAILWAY_PRIVATE_DOMAIN inside the selected project/environment; a temporary service can run the immutable helper.
hosting.limitations: Terminal execution and exact temporary-service cleanup require provider observation. Ready for isolated live acceptance, not live-certified.

hosting.nativeContract: Cloud Run Jobs expose named executions and per-task completion.
hosting.limitations: The current adapter explicitly rejects managedRecoveryTask rather than falling back to its application-image runJob path.

hosting.nativeContract: RunTask uses a task definition and network configuration; DescribeTasks reports exact task ARN and container exits with eventual consistency.
hosting.limitations: No managed private recovery helper executor or exact cleanup contract is implemented in this adapter release.

hosting.nativeContract: Manual Container Apps jobs provide execution status, environment networking, retry limits and execution timeouts.
hosting.limitations: No managed private recovery helper executor or exact cleanup contract is implemented in this adapter release.

hosting.nativeContract: Machines declare images and init commands; the Machines API exposes instance identity, stopped-state waits and auto-destroy.
hosting.limitations: No managed private recovery helper executor or exact cleanup contract is implemented in this adapter release.

hosting.nativeContract: App Platform documents deployment and scheduled jobs.
hosting.limitations: An independent ephemeral private helper dispatch/cleanup contract was not established in this bounded review; the adapter does not implement one.

hosting.nativeContract: Vercel documents bounded Function execution and product-specific compute limits.
hosting.limitations: An arbitrary private temporary helper contract was not established in this bounded review; this does not claim the native product cannot run container images.

storage.nativeContract: Private S3-compatible object storage supports list/get/put/delete operations.
storage.limitations: Railway documentation does not separately establish every S3 conditional-header edge case or strong list consistency. Offline serialized tests cannot certify live compatibility.

storage.nativeContract: Strong object/list consistency; revision-pinned GET and create-only PUT conditions are available, with no cross-key atomic transaction.
storage.limitations: Single PUT is bounded to 5 GiB here; ETags are revision tokens, not assumed SHA256 or MD5 content evidence. Independent SHA256 readback is required.

storage.nativeContract: Strong list consistency and generation/metageneration conditions; generation zero provides create-only writes.
storage.limitations: Compressed stored representations require a raw undecoded media stream and returned generation/length checks. Server transcoding that changes representation fails closed. Native private-worker credential handoff is separate from object streaming.

storage.nativeContract: Strong consistency and ETag conditions cover native revision reads and create-only block-list commits.
storage.limitations: Provider MD5/CRC64 range options do not replace whole-object SHA256 readback. Native private-worker credential handoff is separate from object streaming.
